messages:
maria: Heads-up — customer noticed webhook HMAC failures after our last key rotation. Payloads aren't being accepted by their SIEM. Anyone seen similar?
leo: Which endpoint? webhook delivery or s3 export?
maria: webhook -> /v1/audit/events -> header X-Audit-Signature was failing. They see 401 from our gateway.
anya: we rotated envelope keys at 2025-11-10 02:00 UTC. Did we also rotate the signing key used for webhook signatures?
sam: we rotated KMS master, but signing key (api-signing) was supposed to be stable. Checking.
security-eng: quick check: verifier uses raw payload bytes + key_v1. If we switched to key_v2 there's fallback but only for 7 days. Could be expired.
maria: customer says signature header looks like: `sha256=...;v=2` — our docs show v=1.
leo: ah that means we started emitting v2 format. v2 uses canonicalized JSON (sorted keys) before HMAC. Customer verifier probably expects original ordering.
anya: action: add a compatibility mode to emit v1 using legacy signing for 30 days, and send rollout notice.
sam: filing PR for gateway: include header `X-Audit-Signature-Compat: v1` when legacy mode enabled. pinging infra.
infra-team: note for S3 exports — compressed exports use gzip and partition by tenant_id/date. If customer uses S3->Splunk ingestion, they need to set up extraction to gunzip before HEC. add note to onboarding.
maria: also mapping fields — Splunk wants event_time vs our 'ts' (epoch ms). We should include 'event_time_iso' for compatibility.
security-eng: on SIEM mapping: propose adding top-level fields: event_id, event_type, tenant_id, user_rbac.roles, request.ip, resource.name. Keep snake_case for external customers.
leo: Datadog advise: use `ddsource=audit` and add `service=redwood-audit` tag so they can create pipelines.
maria: sample canonical snippet we can share with customers:
```
{
  "event_id": "evt_01...",
  "event_type": "token.create",
  "tenant_id": "t-123",
  "ts": 1754321987,
  "event_time_iso": "2025-12-03T14:33:07Z",
  "actor": {"id":"usr-1","roles": ["admin"]},
  "resource": {"type":"model","name":"gpt-4o"}
}
```
anya: who owns customer-facing validation harness? we should add a CI job that verifies a customer's webhook/verifier with sample keys.
maria: I'll create onboarding checklist item: key rotation notice, signature version, S3 compression/partition, Splunk field mapping, Datadog tags.
security-eng: also add test for truncated webhooks (we have had truncation with some proxies) — include max payload size and chunking docs.
sam: noted. I'll draft the PR and notify customer success to schedule a sync.
devops-bot: deploy started for gateway-legacy-signing v1.1 -> canary
maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
